title: RC3 / BYODA calibration / red triangle still there
symptom: When calibrating a Dexcom G6 via BYODA shortly after the last BG reading (around 4 minutes), a duplicate BG entry appears in AAPS and a red triangle is shown.
cause: The issue is related to the timing of calibration relative to the BG reading from the transmitter, causing a duplicate BG entry in AAPS. The exact root cause is not fully explained, but it is specific to G6 and not the same as the G5 fix.
fix: MilosKozak applied a second fix (commit 900c5db0dc71c63ddef5e93586fbcd9b58588375) which resolved the issue. The user confirmed that after this fix, calibrating 12 seconds before a new BG read did not produce a duplicate.
evidence_quote: Seems like the 2nd try is the good one :) Just tested at 12 sec before new BG read and didn't have a double in AAPS
